title: Parcel Shop
summary: A shop: the web app calls the API, which stores orders, takes payment and queues fulfilment for a worker.

nodes.label: API
nodes.summary: Lists products, creates orders and takes payment.

nodes.label: Worker
nodes.summary: Fulfils paid orders and emails the shopper.

nodes.label: Redis queue
nodes.summary: Holds fulfilment jobs for the worker.

edges.label: REST
edges.summary: The storefront reads products and posts orders.

edges.label: Read and write
edges.summary: The API reads products and writes orders.

edges.label: Charge card
edges.summary: The API charges the card before queueing fulfilment.

edges.label: Enqueue fulfil
edges.summary: A paid order becomes a fulfilment job.

edges.label: Deliver job
edges.summary: The worker takes jobs from the queue.

edges.label: Update order
edges.summary: The worker updates the order status.

edges.label: Send email
edges.summary: The worker sends the confirmation email.

flows.title: Place an order
flows.summary: From the Pay button to the confirmation email.

messages.label: Insert order
messages.note: The order is stored as pending.

messages.label: Job
messages.note: The worker picks the job up.
